text: I appreciate the opportunity to represent you as your Director on the Crescenta Valley Water District Board. I work to ensure that our community has reliable, clean, and affordable water. I have served on the Crescenta Valley Water District Board for the last seventeen years and have thirty years of experience in the water industry. I have worked on conservation issues, local water supply projects, water storage programs, infrastructure development, and water quality issues. I have considerable experience in managing water projects and keeping within budgets.

- Thirty years water industry experience
- Seventeen years CVWD Director experience
- M.S., Civil Engineering, Stanford University
- B.S., Engineering, California State University Northridge
- Professional Civil Engineer
- Water Treatment and Distribution Operator

- Control and reduce costs
- Improve local supplies
- Improve system reliability during outages and emergencies
- Properly support infrastructure
- Provide safe drinking water to our community

I am committed to managing our water supply in an economically responsible way.
Please vote James Bodnar as your representative.

text: I am a resident of and have lived in La Crescenta for the past 31 years. My wife and I were blessed to have two kids who attended and graduated from our local schools. Representing clients over the last 39 years, I have extensive experience working with state and Federal environmental law related to water quality standards and remediation of soil and ground water.

During my first term as an elected Board of Director of CVWD, I worked (1) to keep rates affordable while continuing to keep our aging pipeline infrastructure from failing; (2) to maintain the highest drinking water quality standards; (3) to improve our water system's viability and survivability in the face of increasing fire risk; and (4) to secure our sources of water and to improve our ability to use locally sourced water.
I would like to continue the work I started four years ago and would appreciate your vote so that I can keep serving our community as a Board of Director of CVWD.
